name: op-secrets
description: 1Password for Claude Code. op-store saves a secret through a native dialog outside the chat (hidden field, reveal toggle) and pipes it to 1Password, never argv or env; op-env resolves op:// references once and launches Claude with the secrets injected, TTY intact; five guard hooks erase pasted secrets before the model sees them and block op read, printenv, .env reads and literal secrets in files. macOS, Windows, Linux.
